Change has been successfully rebased and submitted as ac3a7a6cc59b2dfb113f11d1a296e2cf7260f55a

Move all the telemetry that uses GetInventoryInformation command to 
Inventory.cpp file and remove it from here.  Let Inventory class be a 
place for all inventory properties. If we need to update a common dbus 
interface from this class and Inventory class than create the interface 
in Device class and pass it as constructor parameter to both the 
classes.

Done. MIN_MEMORY_CLOCK and MAX_MEMORY_CLOCK now go through Inventory::registerDramInventory() using the existing Inventory pipeline with retry. NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice only handles GetCurrentClockFrequency (different MCTP command) for MemoryConfiguredSpeedInMhz polling. The dramItemInterface is created in NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice and passed to Inventory via GpuDevice.

See PS2: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88005/2/src/nvidia-gpu/Inventory.cpp#94 https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88005/2/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice.cpp#133

Let's not do this. Let's have one Class per one MCTP VDM command. Please create another class for this MCTP VDM command. This patch is better suited as a child of either of these patches -


https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87801
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87272

Done. Created a separate NvidiaGpuMemoryClockFrequency class for GET_CURRENT_CLOCK_FREQUENCY with MEMORY_CLOCK. Removed all clock polling from NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice. Kept the patch independent as discussed (not chained with 87272) and wait for 87272 patch merge first.

See PS8:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88005/8/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuMemoryClockFrequency.hpp#18
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88005/8/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuMemoryClockFrequency.cpp#27
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88005/8/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuDevice.cpp#142
Why is this check needed? We do not have that for other telemetries.

Done. Removed the redundant if-check. The new class calls set_property directly, consistent with other telemetries.

See PS8:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88005/8/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuMemoryClockFrequency.cpp#81
Could these be std::array?
Done. Changed to std::array<uint16_t, 2>, also updated register_property in https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88005/14/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuDevice.cpp#101 accordingly.
We can just put 1 here directly.
Done. Replaced with 1. See https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88005/14/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuMctpVdm.hpp#279
Looks good, waiting for PDI.

After adding the MHz→MT/s conversion, please re-run busctl and update 405 / 12481 here with the converted values.
Thanks.
Done, thanks.

NSM IDs 28/29 are MHz (per Type 3 spec) but PDI AllowedSpeedsMT is MT/s.
MHz→MT/s conversion is missing here.
Done, thanks.
Earlier you replied "Done. Changed to std::array<uint16_t, 2>" to Harshit's PS12 L68, but this is still `std::vector`.
Done, thanks for review this merge error.
LGTM

The associated PDI patch (https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/+/89182) has had no updates since May 6th and remains on track for merging. The content of this patch will be reworked accordingly if there is any  further updates on the PDI patch.
